signin.title: {p} sign-in is on its way
signin.body: Sign-in arrives when the game server is connected. Start as a guest for now: your garden, gold and treasures stay on this device.
banner.pop: Tap a building to pop it
banner.drop: Tap an empty tile for your next building
ad.title: Rewarded ad
ad.body:
A short video ad would play here.
No real ad is shown in this prototype.
cel.title: New Building!
stuck.title: No Moves Left
stuck.body: Use an item to keep your garden growing, or end this game.
res.title: No More Moves
shop.title: Shop
shop.hint: Tap a card to preview it on your garden
shop.noGold: Not enough gold yet. Yellow bubbles and finished games give gold.
shop.cashBody: {name} ({price}) will be sold in the App Store and Google Play versions. Nothing is charged in this prototype.
rank.title: Ranking
rank.body:
Rankings appear once the game server is connected.
No sample players are shown.

rank.noteAll: Your best score on this device
col.title: Collection
col.findIt: Pop bubbles during a game to find this treasure.
set.title: Settings
tilt.reduce: Reduce Motion is on, so tilt effects are off.
tilt.off: Tilt moves bubbles, water and clouds.
tilt.sensor: Tilt your phone to move bubbles, water and clouds.
tilt.fallback: No motion sensor here: move the mouse, or drag on the sky, to tilt the garden.
t.tapHint: Tap a building, then tap a glowing neighbor to merge.
t.demoSunset: Merge the two Lv 11s to reach Sky Dome and watch the sunset.
t.demoNight: Merge the two Lv 14s to reach Star Observatory and watch night fall.
t.full: No empty tile. Merge a pair or use Bubble Pop.
t.pickBuilding: Pick a tile with a building.
t.bloom: Skybloom Bloom! Two Skybloom Trees burst into light.
t.noEmptyDrop: No empty tile for Cloud Drop.
t.noPair: This one has no matching neighbor yet.
t.saveNA: Saving is not available here. Try the test site in a browser.
t.preparing: Preparing the image… try again in a moment.
t.gfx: The graphics library could not load. Check your connection and reload.
tut.step1: Tap Place to drop a building
tut.step2: Tap both Dew Drops to merge them
tut.done: Nice! Keep merging to grow your garden.

set.logoutBody: Your progress stays on this device.
log.title: Send Play Log
log.body: Saves one file with your last {n} games: every move, bubble pop, item and ad mock-up, plus score and time. No name, e-mail or account ID is included. Send the file to whoever asked you to test.
log.none: No games saved yet. Play a game first, then come back.
